source.assumption: Transverse added mass of a prolate spheroid with length twice its width.
source.citation: Lamb coefficient as tabulated by Munk, NACA Report 184, printed page 20 (PDF page 21): https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19930091249.
source.qualification: The primary table gives 0.702 at length/diameter 2; 0.70 is its rounded surrogate and 1.0 remains a sensitivity assumption. No local primary-source copy is shipped. The potential-flow ellipsoid approximation does not validate the hull or its hanging-bag dynamics.

marginMeaning: Additional downward rotor thrust at the sampled instant, holding aerodynamic force and other electrical loads fixed. Absolute omitted inertia is compared conservatively with that reserve.
massMeaning: Hull dry-mass target, water and nitrogen aboard, plus coefficient times displaced local air mass. Hanging-bag dynamics are excluded.
